purpose: v3 ronda 3 (lectura L1, falsos éxitos M5, lugar M4): where each operation acts, so an order said inside an installed application is never served by a typed operation that acts somewhere else. «app»: in or on the application named (a whole service of it). «piece»: one step a person takes on the screen (open, click, type, open a file with its program); pieces cover an order only clause for clause. «own_store»: BAXY's own notes, tasks, reminders, memory or the files it writes itself. «files»: files read or written directly, without an application. «system»: the whole PC (sound, settings, network). «web»: the web from BAXY's own reading or the person's default browser. semantic.decider.order_served_elsewhere reads it. «made_in_applications»: the elsewhere operations that make what an application itself makes (a note, a presentation, a document, a text file); only these serve another clause of an order that opens an application and goes on («abrí OneNote, creá una página…»). Any other elsewhere operation (the time, the weather, a reminder, the wifi) serves a request of its own there («abrime Steam y fijate qué hora es»), unless the order is one clause said inside the application («en OBS Studio silenciá el micrófono») and the application is not only where the person believes it is done (served_where_said_purpose).
value_pieces_purpose: Uso real v3 ronda 19 (t2-c04 T2 «ahi ponle la escala en 125» → one click on «pantalla»): the pieces that carry a value the person said (the text typed). A follow-up said in the conversation's application that says a number, served only by pieces none of which carries it, is not served: the engine takes it (semantic.decider.leaves_the_said_value).
kept_on_their_route_purpose: Corrección ronda 5 (seguridad): the operations an order said inside an application never loses to the engine, whatever the coverage gate reads: each one confirms before it acts, or polices what it runs (shell.command.run refuses a command that deletes, kills, formats or changes the system), or ends the PC's session (owner rule: never restart, shut down or sign out). Their typed route asks or refuses; the engine would type and press Enter without that. The coverage gate also keeps any operation whose catalog risk is confirmed (__main__._KEEPS_ITS_ROUTE_RISKS).
served_where_said_purpose: Ruta tipada en app (auditoría 2026-10-08, riesgos-fusion 2): an order of one clause said inside an application («en <app> …», semantic.missions.doing_said_in_place) is the engine's in that application only when what it asks is that application's own control. A typed operation away from the application keeps its route when the application is only where the person believes it is done: «remembered_from_any_application» are BAXY's own memory (no typed reader reads it: the decider's choice stands) and «served_from_any_application» BAXY's own reminders and alarms (not the notifications listed or dismissed: every application has its own, «en Discord mostrame las notificaciones»), kept only when the typed readers read the clause without its place as that operation («en Word ponme un recordatorio…»; «en Discord recordale a Juan…» is a message there), and neither in an application that keeps the person's own notes, reminders, alarms or calendar («applications_holding_their_own»: folded words found in order inside the catalog name; «en Outlook creá un recordatorio», «en OneNote guardá que…» are that application's); «system_settings_applications» (folded catalog names, app_aliases.v1.json) are the PC's own settings window, where every system operation the typed readers read in the clause without its place is the one the person means («en Configuración bajá el brillo al 30», «in Settings turn off bluetooth»; never «en configuración de Spotify…», another application's settings); «whole_pc_objects» (folded words) name the whole PC as the object of a system operation said in any application («en Spotify silenciá el PC»). A bare quantifier names no PC (revisión ruta-tipada 1: «todo», «general», «global» are said of the application's own things too: «en Teams silenciá todo», «en OBS silenciá el audio global»). Elsewhere a system operation said in an application is its own control there («en OBS silenciá el audio del escritorio», «en Fotos subí el brillo»). semantic.decider.kept_where_said reads it.
asked_by_name_purpose: v3-27 r9 (live turn audit: «abre el mapa de caracteres y copia el símbolo del euro» → input.keyboard.open, the on-screen keyboard opened and no mission ran): an operation away from the application that is asked only by naming its object (folded words here). An order said inside an application that never names it does not ask it there: it is no request of its own and the order is the engine's (semantic.decider.unasked_operations).
said_by_verb_purpose: Ronda 20 P3 (pasada r18, v3-11 t1 «en onenote crea una pagina nueva» → one input.visible.click on «Página» the decider's restatement brought, «no hay ningún elemento…», and the engine was never tried): the words a person uses to ask one of the screen's own primitives (folded; a trailing * is a word start, two words are said together). A typed route made only of these primitives whose verbs the person's words never say is the decider's paraphrase of an order, not the order: the coverage gate hands it to the engine with the person's words (semantic.decider.primitives_unsaid). An operation not listed here is taken as said.
